about: Reference projects Crucix learns from. Run `node scripts/watchlist.mjs` to see what changed in each since it was last reviewed; `node scripts/watchlist.mjs --mark <id>` records a review. Add a project by adding an entry (keep ids unique).

projects.name: awesome-osint-arsenal
projects.whyWatch: A catalogue of 750+ OSINT tools and sources; new keyless data sources and lookup pages show up here first.

adopted.what: pivot links (Look up elsewhere) in the record inspector
ThreatFox and Have I Been Pwned sources
MISP Galaxy threat actor groups on the country sheet

projects.droppedOrOpen: Most entries are person, phishing or red-team tools that do not fit Crucix. Measured and dropped: Feodo Tracker (5 entries), GLEIF on-demand, Malpedia, ransomware feeds without a licence check.

lastReviewed.note: Full analysis behind v2.14.0 to v2.17.0; head was from 2026-08-29.

projects.name: World Monitor
projects.whyWatch: The closest relative: a real-time global intelligence dashboard with a large source catalogue (docs/data-sources.mdx), country scoring and many panels. New sources, feeds and algorithms appear weekly.

adopted.what: tiered RSS feed registry with source tiers, Hungarian outlets
U.S. travel advisories as a risk component
GPSJam GNSS interference, WMO SWIC warnings
UNHCR Europe sea and land arrivals (idea and portal parameters from seed-cross-border-arrivals.mjs)

projects.droppedOrOpen: Dropped: NGA navigational warnings (newest active one is from 2024), UK FCDO and Smartraveller feeds, the CII v8 score (Crucix keeps its own transparent model), TeleGeography cables (proprietary). Open ideas: more of docs/data-sources.mdx (central banks, CFTC, UNHCR, FAA delays, disease outbreaks), the panels in docs/panels, multi-word keyword entities. Dropped on 2026-10-08: IOM DTM internal displacement (needs DTM_API_KEY), UNHCR refugee-stock situations (overlap between situations, much heavier).

lastReviewed.note: Reviewed the 19 commits up to 1c3ce49 (2026-10-08): took the UNHCR arrivals idea (v2.25.0); IOM DTM needs a key; the rest is World Monitor internals (MCP, forecast, security advisories, China labels).

projects.name: God's Eye View
projects.license: MIT for the code; the bundled datasets keep their own terms (OpenStreetMap/Overture ODbL, TeleGeography CC BY-NC-SA, Natural Earth public domain)
projects.whyWatch: A browser spy-satellite simulator on a 3D globe with live open spatial data; a source of visualisation ideas and data feeds.

adopted.what: mapped military areas, data centres and dams (ODbL data, own build script), nearby sites in the record inspector, FIRMS-on-military-area signal
NHC cyclone forecast track and cone layer, Launch Library 2 launches
military aircraft orbit detection from adsb.lol traces (idea: ask the planet)
Open-Meteo wind at the nuclear sites, NASA GIBS daily satellite basemap

projects.droppedOrOpen: Not taken: CCTV, ALPR, transit, bikeshare, traffic simulation, street level, directions, voice, cockpit, GLSL looks (visual or local-scale, privacy-sensitive); TeleGeography cables (CC BY-NC-SA); full GFS/ECMWF wind animation (GRIB2/WASM, heavy); NOAA infrared cloud mosaic (grayscale, 60S-60N, the GIBS image gives more); NIFC WFIGS perimeters (US only); Radio Browser (KiwiSDR covers HF).

lastReviewed.note: Analysed at 95fa816 (v0.2.1, 1788 files); everything useful was adopted in v2.26.0-v2.30.0.
